row.team_price_text: Usage-priced (ad auction bids); no seat plans
row.evidence: LinkedIn Ads has no seat plans ('costs are based on the type of activity you're paying for and the ad auction'), and Campaign Manager access is granted to LinkedIn members per ad account, by hand, in Business Manager or through the Ad Account Users API; no SCIM or SSO is documented.
row.notes: Campaign Manager users are personal LinkedIn member accounts given roles on an ad account (Viewer, Creative Manager, Campaign Manager, Account Manager, Billing Admin). There is no SCIM endpoint or enterprise SSO for Campaign Manager; Okta's generic 'LinkedIn' OIN app is SWA only. Access is managed by hand in Campaign Manager or Business Manager, or through the Marketing API's Ad Account Users endpoints, which need an app approved for the Advertising API (Development/Standard tiers). Pricing is auction-based, so all price fields are null.

scim.notes: No SCIM for Campaign Manager; ad-account access is per LinkedIn member, managed by hand or through the Ad Account Users API.

endpoints.purpose: Create ad account user (grant a member a role on an ad account)
Update an ad account user's role
Find ad accounts of the authenticated member
Find users of an ad account
Remove a member's access to an ad account

limitations.text: Only existing LinkedIn members (person URNs) can be granted access; the API manages ad-account roles, not accounts.
Advertising API access requires an approved developer app (Development or Standard tier).

user_api.notes: 'partner_only' because the Advertising API is reserved for approved apps; there is no paid plan gate, so api_tax is false.

okta.notes: Generic 'LinkedIn' OIN app; markup ticks SWA only. No Campaign Manager-specific OIN app (linkedin-ads, linkedin-campaign-manager 404).

fallbacks.other_sync: Business Manager: add or remove people across many ad accounts and Pages at once
fallbacks.notes: jit null: users sign in with their own LinkedIn member accounts; no customer-IdP SSO is documented for Campaign Manager.
